english.title: Unauthorised possession in prison of knife or offensive weapon
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without authorisation, were in possession of

(A)_[a bladed or sharply pointed article,]_
(B)_[an offensive weapon as defined in section 1(9) of the Police and Criminal Evidence Act 1984,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE NATURE OF THE ARTICLE / WEAPON..), inside a prison, namely **(..SPECIFY PRISON..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 40CA(1) and (4) of the Prison Act 1952.

english.notes:
(i) In proceedings for this offence it is a defence for the accused to show that he reasonably believed that he had authorisation to be in possession of the article in question, or in all the circumstances there was an overriding public interest which justified his being in possession of the article
(ii) Authorisation means authorisation given for the purposes of this section; and subsections (1) to (3) of section 40E apply in relation to authorisations so given as they apply to authorisations given for the purposes of section 40D

other.penalty:
Either waySummary: 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: 4 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see paragraph 5 of Schedule 4 to the Offender Management Act 2007 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.
